auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to continue your care journey.
auth.registerSubtitle: Choose how you will use this early project version.

assessment.entryRestriction: Assessment entry is currently available for woman accounts. Assigned-patient workflows will be added separately.
assessment.assessmentSubtitle: Record answers as reported. This page does not diagnose medical conditions.
assessment.noActiveSymptoms: No active symptoms are available yet.
assessment.greenExplanation: None of the listed warning signs were reported.
assessment.greenAction: Continue routine care and seek medical advice if symptoms develop or worsen.
assessment.yellowExplanation: This assessment is incomplete because one or more answers were unknown.
assessment.yellowAction: Please complete the assessment or contact a qualified healthcare provider if you are concerned.
assessment.redAction: Please contact a qualified healthcare provider promptly.
assessment.diagnosisDisclaimer: This assessment does not diagnose medical conditions.
assessment.noFacilities: No healthcare facility information is available yet.
assessment.notedSymptoms: Also reported (not included in risk calculation)
assessment.notedDisclaimer: These symptoms were noted by the AI for reference but were not scored by the risk engine.
assessment.pretermLaborRiskExplanation: You are under 37 weeks and have signs of early labour (contractions, fluid leak, or severe abdominal pain). This could mean preterm delivery.
assessment.pretermLaborRiskAction: Go to the nearest hospital or call your doctor immediately. Do not wait.
assessment.posttermPregnancyExplanation: Your pregnancy is past 42 weeks. Overdue pregnancies carry higher risk for you and the baby.
assessment.posttermPregnancyAction: Please contact your doctor or midwife as soon as possible to discuss next steps.

history.subtitle: Review previously saved symptom assessments.
history.noAssessments: No assessments have been saved yet.

pregnancy.subtitle: Keep pregnancy information connected to your assessments.
pregnancy.addDescription: Add your pregnancy details to keep your assessments connected to your pregnancy.

emergencyPanel.title: Emergency calls
emergencyPanel.disclaimer: You place these calls yourself — tapping a button opens your phone's dialer. Nothing is called or sent automatically.

lhw.noWomenAssigned: No women are assigned to you yet.

lhw.noUnassigned: No patients are waiting for assignment right now.

dashboard.nearbyCardDescription: Find hospitals, pharmacies, and clinics near you
dashboard.posttermAlert: This pregnancy is past 42 weeks. Please contact a healthcare provider.
dashboard.enterLmpPrompt: Add your LMP date on the pregnancy page to track your gestational age.

nearby.subtitle: Find hospitals, pharmacies, and clinics close to your current location.
nearby.locationDenied: Location access was denied or is not supported by your browser. You can enter coordinates manually below.
nearby.manualHint: Enter latitude and longitude separated by a comma, e.g. 33.57, 73.04
nearby.noResults: No facilities were found near this location. Try increasing the search radius or moving to a different area.

ai.subtitle: Tell me how you're feeling in your own words
ai.entryRestriction: The AI assistant is currently available for woman accounts only.
ai.greeting: Assalamu alaikum! Main aap ki madad kar sakti hoon. Bataiye, aap ko kaisa mehsoos ho raha hai? Koi takleef ya pareshani hai?
ai.confirmTitle: Ready to start your assessment. Here is what I understood:
ai.assessmentCancelled: No problem. You can tell me more whenever you're ready.
ai.serviceUnavailable: AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try the standard symptom assessment.
ai.micPermissionDenied: Microphone access was denied. Please allow microphone access or type your message.
ai.recordingFailed: The recording was too short. Please try again.
ai.urgentIntentNotice: It sounds like you may need urgent help — here are quick actions.
ai.chatHelper: Tell me how you’re feeling in your own words.

careMission.subtitle: Track and manage follow-up actions from your assessments.
careMission.noMissions: No active care missions. Care missions are created automatically when an assessment results in a Yellow or Red risk level.
careMission.redExplanation: A warning sign was reported during your assessment. Prompt medical attention is recommended.
careMission.yellowExplanation: Your assessment needs follow-up. Please complete the checklist below or contact a healthcare provider.
careMission.noReferral: No referral has been linked to this mission yet.
careMission.updateFailed: Could not update checklist item. Please try again.

referral.subtitle: Track your referral progress from recommendation to facility visit.
referral.noReferrals: No referrals found. Referrals are created by your LHW or doctor when needed.
referral.cancellationNotePlaceholder: Please explain why this referral is being cancelled.
referral.updateFailed: Could not update referral status. Please try again.
